parsed.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a store with glass doors leading outside. Shelves stocked with beverages and goods line the right side. A poster with Chinese characters hangs above the entrance. Outside, palm trees and a bench are visible under bright daylight.

objects.label: glass doors
objects.observation: Double glass doors with metal handles are centered in the frame. They lead to an outdoor area with palm trees and a bench. The doors have a green 'EXIT' sign above them. Bright light from outside illuminates the scene.

objects.label: shelves with products
objects.observation: Shelves on the right hold various packaged drinks and containers. Items include cartons, bottles, and jars arranged neatly. The shelves are mounted against a wall and reflect some ambient light.

objects.label: poster above doors
objects.observation: A blue poster with white Chinese characters and images is mounted above the doors. It appears promotional, possibly for a beverage brand. The text includes '看我多热爱' and other graphics.

objects.label: outdoor bench
objects.observation: A wooden bench is visible through the glass doors, positioned outdoors on a paved surface. Palm trees stand behind it, indicating a tropical or warm climate setting.

objects.label: palm trees
objects.observation: Tall palm trees are seen outside through the glass doors, standing behind the bench. Their fronds are visible against the bright sky, suggesting a sunny day.
